title: Cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="34" ry="8" fill="#ffd966"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <ellipse cx="38" cy="41" rx="3.5" ry="1.8" fill="#ffc4c4"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="43" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#ffc4c4"/>
  <!-- steam -->
  <path d="M40 32 Q37 26 41 20 Q45 14 41 8" fill="none" stroke="#ffb3c8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 30 Q47 24 51 18 Q55 12 51 6" fill="none" stroke="#ff9fb8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 32 Q63 26 59 20 Q55 14 59 8" fill="none" stroke="#ffb3c8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="28" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
